parse.error.ambiguousFormat: The content of {file} matches more than one format with certainty ({formats}), so it is not opened: no format is guessed.
parse.error.archiveDamaged: The ZIP archive is damaged or incomplete.
parse.error.archiveSplit: Split (multi-part) ZIP archives are not supported; join the parts into one archive first.
parse.error.archiveTooLarge: The ZIP archive or the board unpacked from it is too large (the limit is {max} MB).
parse.error.archiveTooManyEntries: The ZIP archive has too many entries (at most {max} are read).
parse.error.archiveEncrypted: {entry} in the ZIP archive is encrypted; unpack it with its password first.
parse.error.archiveMethod: {entry} in the ZIP archive uses compression method {method}; only stored and deflated entries are read.
parse.error.archiveRatio: {entry} in the ZIP archive would expand by more than {ratio}:1, so it is not unpacked.
parse.error.archiveSeveralBoards: The ZIP archive holds more than one board ({entries}), so it is not opened: no board is guessed. Unpack it and open one board.
parse.error.archiveNoBoard: The ZIP archive contains no board file that TRACE can open.
parse.warning.tvwSummary: TVW: pins linked to declared pads: {mapped}; unresolved pad references: {unresolved}; omitted pins: {omitted}.
parse.warning.tvwLimits: TVW import: the board outline and copper traces are not imported. Pad dimensions and side assignments come from the declared layer data; custom shapes are represented by bounding boxes. Pads without a network assignment retain an empty net name. Unsupported or damaged records and pad references cause the import to be refused.
parse.error.appleDoubleMetadata: This is a macOS metadata file (._…), not a board file. Open the file with the same name without the ._ prefix.
parse.error.gencadStorageTrailingBytes: This GENCAD file is wrapped in CAD storage that has non-zero bytes after its text, so the text cannot be read safely. Export the board from the source tool as a text GENCAD 1.4 file and open that file.
parse.error.allegroBrdNative: Cadence Allegro native board database (.brd, format {version}) detected. It is a proprietary binary database that TRACE does not read. Export a GENCAD 1.4 text file from Allegro and open that file, or use Cadence's own viewer.
parse.error.allegroLayoutUnsupported: Allegro native database layout {layout} is unsupported; this reader requires a documented 16.0–17.5 layout. Export a GENCAD 1.4 text file from Allegro and open that file.
parse.error.allegroLayerUnsupported: Allegro footprint layer code {code} is unsupported; supported placed layers are 0 (top) and 1 (bottom). Export a GENCAD 1.4 text file from Allegro and open that file.
parse.error.zipIncomplete: The ZIP archive is damaged or incomplete: its end or its table of contents is missing or cut off. Copy or download the archive again, then open it.
parse.error.zipDirectoryRecord: Record {record} in the ZIP archive's table of contents is missing, damaged or runs past its end. Create the archive again with a standard ZIP tool, then open it.
parse.error.zipEntryHeader: The entry {entry} in the ZIP archive is listed twice, has no valid header, or runs past the end of the archive. Copy or download the archive again, or create it again with a standard ZIP tool, then open it.
parse.error.zip64Damaged: The ZIP64 information of the ZIP archive is damaged or incomplete. Create the archive again with a standard ZIP tool, then open it.
parse.error.zipEntryData: The data of {entry} in the ZIP archive is damaged or does not match its declared size or checksum. Extract the file from its original source, create the archive again, then open it.
parse.error.archiveEntryCount: The ZIP archive lists {entries} entries, but at most {max} are read. Remove the files you do not need or split the archive, then open it again.
parse.error.archiveRatioDeclared: {entry} in the ZIP archive declares a {declared}:1 expansion, above the {limit}:1 limit, so it is not unpacked. Create the archive again without this file, or split it, then open it.
parse.error.archiveBudget: {entry} in the ZIP archive does not fit in the {max} MB limit for the board unpacked from it, so it is not unpacked. Remove the files you do not need, or split the board into smaller archives, then open it again.
parse.error.nativeByteLimit: The Allegro database is larger than {max} MiB, the native import limit, so it is not opened.
parse.error.nativeRecordLimit: The Allegro database declares more than {max} objects, the native record limit, so it is not opened.
parse.error.tvwLayerRange: A top or bottom layer of this TVW file has a coordinate or dimension outside the supported range (more than 20 inches), so the file is not opened: no pad position is guessed.
parse.error.tvwNoPhysicalLayer: This TVW file lists {headers} layer headers before its net table, but none of them is a top or bottom physical layer, so no pads can be placed. The file is not opened.
parse.error.tvwNoNetTable: This TVW file has no complete net table, so its nets and pads cannot be read. The file is not opened: no connectivity is guessed.
parse.error.v3ProjectUnreadable: TRACE cannot read the EasyEDA Pro V3 project {file}: the file is damaged, or it holds no board that TRACE can open. Open the project in EasyEDA Pro and export it again.
parse.error.unrecognized: "{name}" ({extension}): its content matches none of the supported boardview formats, so the file is not opened.

parse.error.cstInvalidNet: CST: pin references an invalid net.
parse.error.cstPinComponent: CST: pin {pin} references component {component}; the declared component count is {count}.
parse.error.cstUnvalidatedLayer: CST: component layer code {code} occurs in real exports but its top/bottom mapping is not validated.

parse.error.csvRowLimit: BV2: row count exceeds the import limit.
parse.error.csvSectionsRequired: BV2: Layout, Nail and Pin sections are all required.
